metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for tool-LLM binding with callback instrumentation in agent workflows. It does not match any existing skill semantically (existing skills cover DOM events, data streams, and timers—different domains entirely). Peer candidates are related but separate: one covers SDK initialization, one covers SwarmZero config, one covers decorator annotation. This skill is orthogonal—it addresses the specific workflow of attaching tools to an LLM instance with observability callbacks, which is a unique capability not covered by peers or existing registry.
